data.name: OneManArmy : the rise of power
data.detailed_description:
OneManArmy: The Rise of Power is an FPS set in a universe inspired by World War II, steeped in a dark and oppressive atmosphere. Throughout puzzle-filled levels, your objective is to reach the required score to progress. This score can be achieved in multiple ways, notably by eliminating your enemies, but that's not all... Explore diverse environments that constantly renew your approach to gameplay.

Game Features:

  • Competitive Leaderboard: For the most seasoned players, a global score—an accumulation of your performance across every level—is displayed and compared with other players worldwide in the main menu.

  • Tactical Weapon Management: No ammunition constraints here: you have unlimited reserves right from the start. To balance this advantage, the impact of distance on damage is crucial. You will constantly need to adapt your arsenal according to the situation.

  • Physics and Puzzles: The game relies on physical interactions with objects to solve certain puzzles and interact with the environment.

  • A Unique Universe: While the game draws its inspiration from the historical context of World War II, it does not strive for realism. It features its own original lore.

  • Content: The game currently offers 13 levels with progressive difficulty. This number is not final: if the game is successful, free updates will further enrich the adventure.

data.short_description: Hunt, solve, and dominate in this dark arcade FPS where every shot counts and only the highest score will allow you to conquer levels and outperform players worldwide.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 4 Go/AMD Radeon RX 560 4 Go
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX

content_descriptors.notes: This game features violence, blood, and corpses depicted in a non-realistic manner. It also includes historical references to the Nazi regime, as these forces serve as the game's primary antagonists. The overall atmosphere is dark, but does not fall into the horror genre.
